feedback: Strong Swiss/international dark data-journalism execution with all requested pages present, correct assets, consistent typography, hairline grid language, red accent discipline, and the intentional defects visible as specified. Main gaps: analytics mobile stacks the four stat tiles as one column instead of the required 2x2 layout; contact mobile sales contact rows overflow/clIP the email/type text; rates desktop/tablet table is visually cramped with truncated headers/timestamps beyond the expected tablet defect; live ticker appears static rather than auto-updating. Overall fidelity is high, but these responsive and behavioral misses keep it below a 9.
